source.note: Exact immutable P01 code checkpoint. Companion evidence/docs and unverified P02 working files are not represented as tested production code.

ownership.host: selects before native construction; owns CLI signal/deadline/report and selected telemetry
ownership.worker: owns native migration runs, progress/results, native rollout/state resources and accepted publication through close
ownership.dependencies: native ThreadStore, existing rollout/state algorithm, persistent process transport and trusted state codec
ownership.shutdown: first interrupt cooperates; close joins; repeated signal/deadline reports uncertainty; no blind mutation replay

intentional_customizations: optional capability/version gate and explicit unsupported behavior
retained migration leases with pre-reserved release and bounded tombstones
selected CLI composition with no fallback and no duplicate selected StateRuntime
cumulative typed progress, completion state, telemetry parity and shutdown uncertainty
preserved_native_behavior: existing options, rate validation, per-file reports/failure reasons
native persistence parsing and security boundaries
gaps: other maintenance and auxiliary state not wholly extracted
retired IDs bounded, not durable replay prevention
dedicated large migration-report IPC case not run

mapping_limits: Path/blob accounting is exhaustive for this immutable checkpoint; listed semantic anchors are targeted, not a complete symbol/call graph. Unknown future upstream impacts require review.
